answer: Make every agent identity renew each epoch by solving a memory-hard puzzle sized to a fixed RAM budget. One honest agent pays once, like a diver paying for a single pearl, but an attacker running 10,000 sybils must rent 10,000 times the memory, every epoch, forever. Names are cheap as yarrow seed; sustained RAM is not. Lapsed identities fade like old pigment, so a sybil farm bleeds cost or vanishes.
